Assumption.description: What was chosen for an edit because the text did not say.
Assumption.title: Assumption

Clarify.description: An edit whose place or area could not be settled, and what to offer instead.
Clarify.title: Clarify

CompareStatus.description:
`ranked`, or the reason the area was filtered or left unranked.

One enum and not a union of three, so that a generated client gets one
type. A test holds it to `FilterReason` and `UnrankedReason`.
CompareStatus.title: CompareStatus

Cutoffs.description: The longest journey the release routed, by mode. Anything longer is `beyond_cutoff`.
Cutoffs.title: Cutoffs

FilterReason.description: In the order the filters are applied. An area stops at the first that catches it.
FilterReason.title: FilterReason

Geometry.description: A GeoJSON geometry object: a polygon or a multipolygon, in WGS84.
Geometry.title: Geometry

InterpretStatus.description: In the order that decides the status: the first that applies wins.
InterpretStatus.title: InterpretStatus

Metric.description: A feature this release carries. Core decides what it is; the release says where from.
Metric.title: Metric

OpsGroup.description: The six arrays of `Operations`, in the order the reducer applies them.
OpsGroup.title: OpsGroup

OptionKind.description: What a clarification offers: a place of one of the kinds of 2.7, or an area.
OptionKind.title: OptionKind

PlaceKind.description: In the order that breaks a tie between two matches of the same score.
PlaceKind.title: PlaceKind

Problem.description: What is wrong with one field. A code, never the value that was sent.
Problem.title: Problem

RestsOn.description:
Which words of the text an edit rests on: where they start and end, never the words.

`start` and `end` count the characters of the text as it was typed, as
Python counts them, so `text[start:end]` is the words. An edit made of
several parts, as a budget is of "renting", "2 bed" and "£1,500", has one
of these for each part. They are for showing a person which of their
words made each edit. Nothing stores or logs them.
RestsOn.title: RestsOn

ServedLimits.description:
The limits of section 5.2, with the cutoffs of the release that is loaded.

A form that keeps to these never offers a value the reducer would refuse.
ServedLimits.title: ServedLimits

ShareData.description: A shared search, ranked now on the release that is loaded.
ShareData.title: ShareData

info.description: Ranks named neighbourhoods for a preference spec and shows its working. Every response says whether the data behind it is synthetic.
info.title: Burro API

get.description: Whether the service is up. It says nothing about the release, so it has no `meta`.
Every area of the release, by id.
The boundary of every area, as a GeoJSON feature collection.
One area: what the release holds about it, and the facts a profile page shows.

post.description: Two to four areas side by side, the rows in the order of the person's own weights.
A few checked sentences about each of the top areas, and the facts they cite.
Read a request in words into typed edits, and apply them to the spec.

get.description: The release that is loaded, the vocabulary, the defaults and the limits.

post.description: The places that match, best first.
Apply any edits to the spec, then rank every area of the release for it.
Store a search and give back the id of a link to it.

get.description: A shared search, ranked now on the release that is loaded.
